content.short: Libeara is a tokenization platform, incubated by Standard Chartered, for bonds and fund units.
content.description: Libeara is an asset tokenization platform launched by Standard Chartered's SC Ventures and based in Singapore, turning instruments such as government bonds and fund units into on-chain tokens. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Libeara.
content.meta: Libeara is Standard Chartered-incubated tokenization of bonds and funds, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
